pages.title: Merry Christmas
pages.concept: Father Christmas cycles home after completing his gift deliveries, travelling diagonally through a twinkling midnight city street beneath trailing fairy lights.
pages.artwork_description: The lower half features an original, friendly Father Christmas in a cranberry coat and cream-trimmed hat cycling briskly from lower left towards lower right. His bicycle basket and rear rack are piled with neatly wrapped parcels, with one small evergreen sprig tucked among them. A simplified city street recedes behind him, with glowing shop windows, snowy rooftops, a small crescent moon and looping golden fairy lights. Leave the upper third as open cobalt sky for the greeting.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact title text: “Merry Christmas”. Portrait card front: original Father Christmas cycling diagonally across the lower half of a twinkling midnight city street, parcel-filled bicycle, trailing fairy lights overhead, glowing shop windows, snowy rooftops and open cobalt sky in the upper third for the hand-lettered greeting.
pages.production_notes: Verify the title is exactly “Merry Christmas” and fully legible. Keep the cyclist, bicycle and parcels clear of the fold/trim area. Preserve the open upper-sky area and avoid excessive dark ink coverage across the entire panel.

pages.title: Warm Wishes
pages.concept: A quiet, coordinated interior greeting panel with a small festive continuation of the cycling scene and ample space to write.
pages.artwork_description: A warm cream interior panel with the printed greeting centred in the upper half: “Wishing you a very merry Christmas”. Along the bottom edge, show a small simplified vignette of Father Christmas’s parked bicycle beside a glowing shopfront, with two parcels, a tiny spruce tree and a few scattered gold stars. Leave the centre and lower-middle area mostly blank for a personal message.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact title text: “Wishing you a very merry Christmas”. Card inside panel with a warm cream writing area, a small bottom-edge vignette of a parked parcel-filled bicycle beside a glowing shopfront, two wrapped parcels, tiny spruce tree and a few gold stars; leave broad uncluttered space for a handwritten message.
pages.production_notes: Verify the greeting text exactly, including lower-case “very merry Christmas”. Ensure the central and lower-middle writing area remains unillustrated with sufficient contrast for pen ink. Position artwork away from the fold line.

pages.title: Night Shift
pages.concept: A restrained back-panel sign-off that echoes the joyful night-time journey without competing with the front.
pages.artwork_description: A mostly cream back panel with a small circular midnight-blue vignette near the lower third: a distant Father Christmas silhouette riding his bicycle beneath a single string of fairy lights, passing simplified snowy rooftops. Above it, add a small hand-lettered line reading “Night shift complete”. No branding or logo.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact title text: “Night shift complete”. Card back panel with a mostly warm cream field and a small circular midnight-blue vignette near the lower third: distant Father Christmas silhouette cycling beneath one string of fairy lights past simplified snowy rooftops; no logo, no additional text.
pages.production_notes: Verify the text is exactly “Night shift complete”. Keep the panel deliberately minimal and do not add branding. Include the separate printing and folding guide as an unillustrated deliverable component; it is not an artwork page.

selected_pages.reason: First content page (card-front): sets the core illustration style.
A different page type (card-inside) tests a different layout and activity structure.
A later page (card-back, p3) checks the shared style stays consistent across the product.

images.prompt:
Contemporary hand-painted gouache illustration with visible warm paper grain, layered opaque shapes, softly dry-brushed edges and crisp fine ink-like accents. Use a festive jewel-and-cream palette with cobalt and spruce shadows, cranberry notes and luminous gold highlights; gentle painted shading, warm practical glows, expressive rounded character design, refined hand-lettered accents and an upbeat, cosy printed-card finish.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Richly textured contemporary gouache illustration with layered painted shapes and refined editorial charm.; line weight: Fine crisp ink-like accents with varied, restrained weight.; line quality: Slightly organic hand-drawn contours with neat, confident finishing details.; detail level: Moderate-to-high detail concentrated around the focal storytelling elements; supporting areas use simplified layered forms.; character language: Friendly, stylised human figures with softly rounded proportions, expressive faces and lively, readable gestures.; background density: Atmospheric medium-density surroundings built from simplified repeating forms, with carefully preserved breathing room for the greeting.; composition: Clear focal hierarchy with an energetic directional flow, a generously uncluttered area for typography, and balanced decorative framing details.; palette: Festive jewel tones balanced by warm cream, with deep blue-green shadows, cranberry accents and luminous golden highlights.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Soft opaque gouache shading, gentle cast shadows and small warm highlights; no harsh digital gradients.; texture: Visible warm paper grain, lightly dry-brushed paint edges and subtle printed-card tactility.; mood: Joyful, brisk, cosy and warmly nostalgic..

PAGE 1 of "Father Christmas on the Night Shift" (card-front): Exact title text: “Merry Christmas”. Portrait card front: original Father Christmas cycling diagonally across the lower half of a twinkling midnight city street, parcel-filled bicycle, trailing fairy lights overhead, glowing shop windows, snowy rooftops and open cobalt sky in the upper third for the hand-lettered greeting.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with an illustrated background that is part of the artwork. The artwork runs to every edge (full bleed). Keep all text and key elements inside a comfortable inner safe area. It must look like a finished, retail-quality greeting card design, not a colouring page or worksheet. Create a folded portrait card with an illustrated front and back, and a warm cream inside panel with generous clear space for a handwritten message. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any resemblance to existing branded Father Christmas depictions, logos or recognisable card designs; Photorealism or 3D-rendered plastic surfaces; Overly childish cartoon proportions or exaggerated facial features; Cluttered backgrounds that compete with the greeting; Harsh neon colours, muddy shadows or heavy digital gradients; Misspelled, distorted or illegible typography; Fine details too small or low-contrast for home printing.
